title: Employment transfer executed without a consent-regime determination
notes: declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until thresholds are set (design Decision 8). Escalation, not halt: the jurisdiction's employment-transfer regime (TUPE / Korean 영업양도 doctrine) must be determined and applied before people move; Korean succession is judicial doctrine (Supreme Court 2000다8448 line) — individual-consent path is the safe practice (ADR-0051, verify with counsel).
